slides.title: Signs you’re living *like roommates*
slides.sub: And how to turn the heat back up.

slides.title: Your texts are *shopping lists*
slides.body: Turn it up: one flirty text a day.

slides.title: You eat in *different rooms*
slides.body: Turn it up: sit together, even for snacks.

slides.title: Date night is *“maybe next week”*
slides.body: Turn it up: book one for this week.

slides.title: You only touch *by accident*
slides.body: Turn it up: a six-second hug.

slides.title: You haven’t *laughed together* lately
slides.body: Turn it up: watch something silly.

slides.title: Goodbyes are a quick *“see ya”*
slides.body: Turn it up: look up and say “love you.”

slides.title: Save this *and turn it up tonight.*
slides.sub: Start with number four. It takes six seconds.
